_rules: Counters only increase. An ID is never reused or reassigned, including IDs of DEPRECATED items.
ids[] is append-only. Set retired: true instead of removing an entry.
fingerprint = sha1 of lowercased `type|sorted source US-IDs|normalised title`; used by update mode to match existing items before minting a new ID.
US-### IDs are owned by the User Story Agent and are recorded here only for traceability.
